newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BONDS HOLD, SHORT FORWARDS DIP, ECU/DRS IDLES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BONDS HOLD, SHORT FORWARDS DIP, ECU/DRS IDLES.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was trading narrowly hugging the 311.35 level, depos and bonds were holding late Friday levels and short-dated forex forwards were softer in subdued early dealings with British and U.S markets closed, traders said.

"Interbank depos are holding late afternoon levels in subdued trading," said a dealer at a private bank. "Implied drachma rates from forex forwards are down 20 to 30 basis points in periods up to two-weeks."
Depo levels discounted a tighter interbank liquidity in the near future due to June's T-bill and fixed coupon bond issues, said a foreign bank dealer.
The treasury will issue 12-month T-bills at 9.60 percent on June 2, down 10 basis points, reopen bids for three-, five- and seven-year coupon bonds and auction 10-year fixed coupon bonds on June 19.
Greece auctioned three-year, 9.80 percent bonds, five-year, 9.20 percent bonds and seven-year, 8.9 percent bonds on March 19.
Prices of fixed coupon bonds, FRNs and two-year zeros were little changed in the absence of trading incentives.
"Very few deals have taken place since this morning and prices are nearly unchanged from Friday," said a dealer. "London and U.S are closed today so I expect a quiet day."
The mark was quoted at 159.75/85 from Friday's 159.590 fix, the dollar at 269.24/34 drachmas from 270.500 and the ecu at 311.31/41 from 311.150 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is hovering around 311.35 holding late Friday levels," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "Activity is subdued with London and U.S. markets closed today."
The repercussions from the French election outcome should be reflected on Tuesday's trading when London and U.S markets open, the dealer said.
U.S markets are closed today in observance of Memorial Day.
